summary: Names of stats the game computes for a player, read-only and in the game's units, for use with Player.derivedStat. Bleeding, sleeping, consciousness, drunkenness and poisoning arrive with the vitals, and the rest are sampled from the player's game.

Bleeding.exampleLua:
local DerivedPlayerStat = kcds.players.DerivedPlayerStat

if player:derivedStat(DerivedPlayerStat.Bleeding) > 0 then
  kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, "You are bleeding.")
end

Sleeping.summary: 'sleeping': whether and how deeply the player sleeps.
Sleeping.exampleLua:
local DerivedPlayerStat = kcds.players.DerivedPlayerStat

if player:derivedStat(DerivedPlayerStat.Sleeping) > 0 then
  print(tostring(player.nickname) .. " sleeps")
end

Drunkenness.exampleLua:
local DerivedPlayerStat = kcds.players.DerivedPlayerStat

if player:derivedStat(DerivedPlayerStat.Drunkenness) > 50 then
  kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, "You sway.")
end

Charisma.summary: 'charisma': the player's charisma as the game evaluates it.

Visibility.exampleLua:
-- A sneaking contest: the least visible player wins.
local DerivedPlayerStat, Player = kcds.players.DerivedPlayerStat, kcds.players.Player

local winner, lowest = nil, math.huge
for _, one in ipairs(Player.all()) do
  local seen = one:derivedStat(DerivedPlayerStat.Visibility)
  if seen < lowest then
    winner, lowest = one, seen
  end
end
Visibility.exampleCs:
// A sneaking contest: the least visible player wins.
var winner = Player.All().OrderBy((one) => one.DerivedStat(DerivedPlayerStat.Visibility)).FirstOrDefault();

Conspicuousness.summary: 'conspicuousness': how much the player stands out.

Noise.summary: 'noise': how much noise the player makes.

Dirtiness.exampleLua:
if player:derivedStat(kcds.players.DerivedPlayerStat.Dirtiness) > 0.5 then
  kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, "The innkeeper wrinkles his nose.")
end

Fragrance.summary: 'fragrance': perfume or soap on the player.

CarriedWeight.exampleLua:
local DerivedPlayerStat = kcds.players.DerivedPlayerStat

local load = player:derivedStat(DerivedPlayerStat.CarriedWeight)
local capacity = player:derivedStat(DerivedPlayerStat.InventoryCapacity)
if load > capacity then
  kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, "You carry too much.")
end

InventoryCapacity.summary: 'inventoryCapacity': the weight the player can carry unencumbered.

ArmorRating.summary: 'armorRating': the armour rating of what the player wears.

OverallArmorDefense.exampleLua:
-- A tournament for lightly armoured players.
local DerivedPlayerStat = kcds.players.DerivedPlayerStat

if player:derivedStat(DerivedPlayerStat.OverallArmorDefense) > 100 then
  kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, "Too much armour for this bout.")
end

OverallWeaponAttack.summary: 'overallWeaponAttack': the attack of the player's weapon.

NormalizedRunSpeed.summary: 'normalizedRunSpeed': the player's run speed relative to normal.
